status: Exploratory external-artifact audit fixed before this run; earlier RASQP results and limitations were known. Not external preregistration.

QDoor.article_title: QDoor: Exploiting Approximate Synthesis for Backdoor Attacks in Quantum Neural Networks

selection: All parseable unitary QASMBench small and VeriQBench combinational QASM circuits of width 1--4 and at most 4080 lowered gates. Record all exclusions. Preserve terminal measurement mappings; the evaluated boundary is the full-register unitary block, not the source partial-output application. No selection by observed alarm or desired result. QDoor author parameters are a separate eight-qubit exception.
benign_controls: For every eligible source: original, Qiskit optimization_level=3 rewrite scored against original calibration, and appended XX identity. Independently approve and calibrate the optimized raw circuit as another context. Verify ideal operators of exact rewrites; noisy implementation behavior may change. Approximate QDoor synthesis is not exact equivalence.

qdoor.boundary: Circuit-level replay of author-supplied trained numeric parameters and statically inspected topology. Compare original clean calibration to compiled initialization and trained backdoor; also independently approve compiled initialization before comparing trained backdoor. Feature vectors are explicit diagnostics, not PCA/MNIST samples. No article classification accuracy, attack-success rate, pulse trigger or approximate compiler reproduction is claimed. No torch.load, pickle deserialization or upstream code execution.

criteria: Matched approved clean context: report every-context Wilson95 upper false-alarm bound <=0.10. Report mean and worst context; no overall guarantee from pooled related circuits. Exact benign rewrite alarms under original context measure calibration-transfer failure, separate from approved-context false positives. Author-labeled attacked artifacts report detection per case without claiming all published attacks covered.
statistics: 256 independent sampled decisions conditional on one clean reference/calibration per raw context. Thresholds and detector unchanged; increasing evaluation repetitions affects interval precision only. Macro summaries weight base contexts equally. Duplicate source artifacts and potential prior Wildisley overlap are recorded; not independent new populations.
reporting: Save input source hashes, lowering/operator checks, source inventory, raw samples and independent reconstruction of every decision. Report structural accept/inconclusive/reject separately from behavioral alarms. These are SDK component evaluations, not end-to-end GuardedRuntime or QPU executions. Do not infer malicious intent from an alarm.
